purpose: Independent practice of B1.1 — reading and representing numbers to 50 in five forms.
student_learning_goal: I can read and represent numbers to 50 in many ways and tell where I see numbers in everyday life.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can read and represent numbers to 50 in many ways and tell where I see numbers in everyday life.
header.character_watermark: Otto in the top-right corner, holding two jars of marbles. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Each row shows the same number in two ways. Draw a line to match the numeral on the left to the picture on the right.
parts.visual_layout: Top third of the page. A 5-row matching grid. Left column: numerals 12, 25, 38, 47, 30 in random order. Right column: matching representations (ten-frames for 12, base-ten rods for 25, tally marks for 38, base-ten rods for 47, ten-frames for 30) in random order. The child draws lines.

image_placeholders.description: A 5-row matching grid in B&W line-art. Left column: numerals 12, 25, 38, 47, 30 (random order). Right column: a ten-frame visual showing 12, base-ten rods showing 25, tally marks for 38, base-ten rods for 47, ten-frames for 30 (random order, NOT aligned to left column). Each row ~1in tall. Connector dots between columns for the child's lines.
image_placeholders.placement: Top third of the page; full-width matching grid.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_MATCH_GRID: keywords (match, numerals, ten-frame, rods) name what the grid shows.

parts.answer_key: 12 → ten-frame 12. 25 → base-ten rods 25. 38 → tally marks 38. 47 → base-ten rods 47. 30 → ten-frame 30.

parts.student_instructions: Match each numeral to its word. Draw lines.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of the page. A 6-row table. Left column: numerals 5, 12, 25, 38, 50, 47 (in order). Right column: words 'twelve', 'forty-seven', 'fifty', 'five', 'twenty-five', 'thirty-eight' (random order). Child draws lines.

image_placeholders.description: A 6-row matching table in B&W line-art. Left column: numerals 5, 12, 25, 38, 50, 47 each in a small box. Right column: number-words 'twelve', 'forty-seven', 'fifty', 'five', 'twenty-five', 'thirty-eight' in random order each in a small box. Connector dots between columns.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_NUMERAL_WORD_MATCH: keywords (numerals, words, match) name what the table shows.

parts.answer_key: 5 → five. 12 → twelve. 25 → twenty-five. 38 → thirty-eight. 50 → fifty. 47 → forty-seven.

parts.student_instructions: Pick a number between 10 and 50. Show it FIVE ways: numeral, word, ten-frames, base-ten rods, tally marks.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Five labelled boxes in a 2-row layout: NUMERAL (top-left small box), WORD (top-middle box), TEN-FRAMES (top-right box), BASE-TEN RODS (bottom-left box), TALLY MARKS (bottom-right box). Each ~2in × 1.8in for drawing.

image_placeholders.description: Five labelled blank boxes in a 2-row layout in B&W line-art. Top row: NUMERAL (~1.5in), WORD (~2.5in), TEN-FRAMES (~2.5in). Bottom row: BASE-TEN RODS (~3in), TALLY MARKS (~3in). Each box has a thin grey outline and a header label.
image_placeholders.placement: Bottom of the page; spans full width.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_FIVE_WAYS_BOXES: keywords (numerals, words, rods, tally) name the five forms shown.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any number 10-50 shown correctly in all 5 forms. Common pick: 25 = twenty-five = 2.5 ten-frames = 2 rods + 5 ones = 5 groups of 5 tally marks.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, flip the page over and pick a HARDER number (40-50). Show it five ways!
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Hand out at the end of the gallery walk. Watch for: (a) Part 1 children who match by guessing rather than reading the representations; (b) Part 3 children who skip the harder forms (base-ten rods, tally marks) — flag for re-loop. Use Part 3 as evidence for the formative tracker columns 'reads ten-frame' and 'reads base-ten rod' (children who can SHOW the form can also read it).
